test_case.test_name: Parameterized 60-second all-GPU RVS GST DGEMM exerciser
test_case.purpose: Exercise double-precision GEMM concurrently on every approved GPU for the source-defined 60000 duration and verify compute plus per-device health against approved performance, error, thermal and power limits.
required_package: Pinned RVS/GST and ROCm/driver versions with checksums and config schema
Exact dgemm.conf preserving alpha=1, beta=1, 28000 matrices/LDs, device=all, parallel=true, target_stress=70000, duration=60000 and log_interval=5000
Stable GPU UUID/BDF/device map and expected device count
Approved RVS result/error and any performance thresholds
Workload isolation, cooling/power/timeout aborts and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After artifact, config, topology, oracle and load approval, run `/opt/rocm/bin/rvs -c /opt/rocm/share/rocm-validation-suite/conf/dgemm.conf` with the verified source-equivalent config. Retain the entire RVS log and synchronized per-GPU utilization/clock/temperature/power/ECC/XID/link evidence; do not truncate to tail output.
test_case.expected_result: All expected GPUs participate for the full source duration, RVS/GST reports the approved successful result and any required performance limit, and no GPU throttling beyond policy, ECC/XID, PCIe/xGMI, thermal, power, kernel or BMC fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact config/artifact provenance, complete all-GPU participation, full-duration execution, the approved RVS/performance oracle and clean per-device health. Exit zero or a tail fragment cannot pass; absent thresholds prevent PASS.
safety_gate: All-GPU DGEMM is active compute/memory stress and requires explicit load approval.
Confirm cooling/PSU headroom, workload isolation and stable UUID/BDF mapping before start.
Track the exact process and enforce duration plus timeout; 60 seconds must not be presented as a substitute for another formal long-duration case.
Abort on missing GPU, RVS error, XID/ECC/link fault, thermal/power threshold or lost OOB; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate dmesg-scrub identity
RVS/ROCm/driver checksums and complete config checksum/content
Stable GPU UUID/BDF map and full timestamped RVS log
Approved oracle/threshold comparison, kernel/BMC logs and clean return to idle
test_case.recovery: Terminate only the tracked RVS process on abort, preserve full logs and per-device state, verify every GPU and link returns healthy/idle, and use approved service/reboot recovery only if required. Do not rerun automatically.
